A '''vibration cell''' was a type of [[Energy cell (vibroblade)|energy cell]] used during the [[Old Sith Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR1" /> It could be equipped onto certain types of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]], such as [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].<ref name="KOTOR2" /> In order to be integrated, it required a high quality weapon and a workbench with adequate tools. When added to the weapon, it acted to stabilize the blade, allowing it to more reliably hit and damage targets.<ref name="KOTOR1" /> It also made the blade slightly unwieldy and difficult to use, a weakness that was improved in later models.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

It saw use during the [[Jedi Civil War]], where it was utilized by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. The device was also carried by some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It could be purchased from many vendors throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="KOTOR1" /> The energy cell was still in use during the [[First Jedi Purge]], by which time several upgraded models had been developed. These included Mark II, III, and IV versions. Each subsequent model improved the performance of the device, while reducing the effect on wielding difficulty. These models were able to be crafted with the right components and tools, but required additional skill and materials for the better versions.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vibration cells first appeared as an upgrade item in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR1" /> They later appeared in the [[2004]] sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. The items are not involved in any quest or alignment change.<ref name="KOTOR2" /><ref name="KOTOR1" />
